cases.name: baseline
cases.text: Whenever you roll a die, you may reveal the top card of your library. Do this only once each turn. Whenever you reveal a card with mana value less than the result this way, you may exile it. If you do, you may play it this turn.

cases.name: greater comparison
cases.text: Whenever you roll a die, you may reveal the top card of your library. Do this only once each turn. Whenever you reveal a card with mana value greater than the result this way, you may exile it. If you do, you may play it this turn.

cases.name: combat duration

cases.name: reject wrong destination
cases.text: Whenever you roll a die, you may reveal the top card of your library. Do this only once each turn. Whenever you reveal a card with mana value less than the result this way, you may put it into your graveyard. If you do, you may play it this turn.
